name: uml-fragment-frame
description: Visio UML sequence fragment mapping for native VSDX generation. Every alt must drop the UML sequence stencil's 替代片段 / Alternative fragment master, keep the diagram header text as alt, replace the native [條件] placeholder for the first branch condition, normalize operand regions after layout, and keep first-branch condition heads without an extra visible top separator. opt uses the container-capable native Alternative fragment variant with the displayed operator set to opt when the Optional fragment master does not expose container membership/control behavior.
